content_fields.title: Verify that Transparent Data Encryption is utilized with Enterprise Databases
content_fields.description: Verify that transparent data encryption is in effect on the database.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the encryption setting is active on the running instance and that raw data files do not reveal table contents.
content_fields.found: No encryption at rest is configured, so there is nothing yet to verify.
content_fields.missing: The database encryption configuration that would be the subject of the check.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification depends on a database setting applied outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should verify encryption once it is enabled.
